abstract: This study was designed to examine haemoglobin F levels prior to therapy in 39 patients with testicular tumours (10 seminoma, 29 non-seminomatous tumours) and 20 controls. HbF levels were significantly increased in the group with testicular tumours (1.66 +/- 0.12%) compared with normal controls (0.99 +/- 0.08%) (P less than 0.001). Non-seminomatous tumours had more pronounced levels than seminomas (P less than 0.001). No correlation was found between HbF level and stage of the disease. We suggest that HbF production could be significantly reactivated in adult patients with testicular tumours and may be a useful marker.
abstract_ja: 治療前の精巣腫瘍患者39例（セミノーマ10例、非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍29例）と対照20例において、ヘモグロビンF値を検討した。精巣腫瘍群のHbF値（1.66 ± 0.12%）は正常対照（0.99 ± 0.08%）と比較して有意に高値であった（P<0.001）。非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍は、セミノーマよりも顕著な高値を示した（P<0.001）。HbF値と病期との間には相関は認められなかった。成人の精巣腫瘍患者ではHbF産生が有意に再活性化されており、有用なマーカーとなりうると考えられる。
